responsibility: This implementation module implements the Logitech-compatible legacy formatting layer that converts integer values into fixed character arrays. It delegates actual numeric formatting to StringConvert routines, uses DynamicStrings as temporary storage, and copies the final text into caller-provided ARRAY OF CHAR buffers for octal, hexadecimal, unsigned decimal, and signed integer conversions.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for Conversions: unlike Conversions.def, it realizes the conversion routines by calling StringConvert helpers and copying the resulting DynamicStrings text into caller-provided CHAR arrays.
